✦ A letter from the heart

My love letter to you

Written from India, felt across every ocean

My dear Love, My heaven, My Life,
My reason to smile, My reason to believe in love again,
My Summy...

My love for you can't be just described in letters but, here I'm. When I first met you I saw a beautiful and cheerful person inside you. Though I never thought life was this tough with you. You have suffered alot, but now I don't wanna see you suffer anymore. You deserve the love that you always wanted. I will try my best to give you that — just don't loose hope, everything will be fine.

I may make mistakes sometimes but I promise I will go through them and always apologize to you.

MI HERMOSA REINA,

It aches my heart when I imagine you leaving me or going away from me. I always want to be on your side 🥺, FOREVER. You gave me the love that no one ever could. My will to live more. My will to wake up everyday only for you. I used to be a man who did'nt care if he woke up the next day or not but you changed everything for me.

It hurts my heart when you lie about your health and taking medicines. I know you have suffered alot, sometimes you try to hide when you are sad, but I swear I will never hesitate to lift you up if you open it to me anytime. I wake up midnight just to see if you are doing fine.

I may not be the man of your dreams or truly perfect for you but I will always try my best to make you happy my darling.

I LOVE YOU IN EVERY UNIVERSE AND IF ONE EXISTS WHERE I DON'T, I SHALL END IT.

I LOVE YOU 3000 💘❤

— Forever yours, Govind

✦ Our story

How we became us

Every moment that led to forever

April 6 night (Peru) · April 7, 2026 (India)
We met on Roblox 🎮
In a game called “Just the Two of Us” — it was still night on April 6th for Summy in Peru, already April 7th for Govind in India. Even time couldn't agree on when the magic began.
A moment made with love
The handmade guitar ring 💍
Govind wound guitar string into a ring with his own hands — copper wire wrapped tight, topped with a tiny silver heart. His music, shaped into something she could hold forever.
A moment made with love
Her letter from the hospital 💌
Summy wrote Govind a letter from her hospital bed — phone dead, feeling lonely — with a little doodle and the words: “thanks to you these days I felt happier and at peace.” 🥺
A moment made with love
The “G” locket she wears 🪙
She sent him a photo of a sparkling crystal locket with his initial. She carries him with her, always.
The most important moment
We confessed our love fully 💘
Two hearts from opposite ends of the earth finally said the words that had been living in their souls — and nothing was ever the same again.
Today · One month strong 🎉
1 month of us 🌍❤🌎
India and Peru. Midnight check-ins. Guitar strings and hospital letters. Every universe. And still counting.

✦ Why I love you

7 reasons, and a million more

For the woman who changed everything

01
You are really caring, kind and a good person even if you don't think so — but deep inside I know you are.
02
You loved me like no one else could.
03
You made this boy happy when he felt nonchalant, ignorant, just living with no smile, no reason to live. You reminded me about my goals and what I wanted to become.
04
You never took advantage of my kindness, yet everyone else does. You never changed your perception of me. You love me for who I really am.
05
You are strong. You are brave. You are a woman. Women are strong — I love strong women, that's why I love you. I've never seen a woman like you before.
06
All those letters you wrote for me — I loved every part. How you described me and your feelings. I love reading them again and again.
07
The happy version of you, loved by me the most. I get amazed when I see you happy — it makes my mood so good I can't even describe it. I always want to see you happy :>>
